message: 10% discount with the promo code Aug10%OFF
detailsBody:
Book any day tour during August and take 10% off the listed price — shared or private, any language.

- Enter the code Aug10%OFF at checkout, under "Have a referral or promo code?"
- The discount applies to the tour price (optional add-ons are charged in full)

Questions? Message us on WhatsApp — we answer fast.

promoCodes.note: August promo advertised in the announcement bar
